name: Acolyte Hybrid

bonuses.name: Extra Arm
bonuses.text: This Threat has 3 arms. If this Threat is wielding a one-handed weapon in each hand, or a one-handed weapon in one hand and a two-handed weapon in its other two hands, it can make one attack with each weapon without suffering a Multi-Attack DN penalty. If this Threat is wielding a weapon with all 3 hands, they can take the Brace Action (Wrath & Glory, page 189) as a free action.

abilities.name: Unquestioning Loyalty
abilities.text: When a Threat with the GENESTEALER CULT and PSYKER Keywords within 6m of this Threat is targeted by a ranged attack, this Threat may interpose themself as a reaction and become the new target for the attack.
Blasting Charge (1): Text. Frag Grenade (1): Text. (Printed as the placeholder word "Text", no profile.)

options.name: Acolyte Options
options.text: An Acolyte Hybrid can exchange their Autopistol for a Hand Flamer (no profile printed). They may also exchange both their Autpistol and Cult Knife for any of the following options.

options.name: Acolyte Leader
options.text: Some Mobs of Acolytes have leaders designated by their Patriarch or the Broodmind. +1 Toughness, meaning they also have 8 Resilience and 7 Wounds. +1 Willpower, meaning they also have 6 Shock, 5 Conviction, and 4 Resolve. An Acolyte leader has the following instead of an Autopistol and Cult Knife. An Acolyte Leader may also carry either a Cult Icon (as long as this Threat is alive, all other Threats with the GENESTEALER CULT Keyword that can see the Cult Icon gain +1 Conviction and Resolve) or a Cult Lash Whip (once per Round, a single individual within 4m of this Threat can reroll an attack Test).

mobAbilities.name: Broodmind
mobAbilities.text: This Threat gains a +3 bonus dice to Resolve Tests when within 20 metres of a Threat with the GENESTEALER CULT and PSYKER Keywords.

note: Reprint of acolyte-hybrid; differs in Tier row (A E E T T; Core A E T T), Wounds 6 (Core 8), skills, Autopistol and Cult Knife profiles, options. Print errors kept: Blasting Charge and Frag Grenade profiles are the word 'Text'; 'Autpistol'.
